eligibilityText: All necessary Open Call documents are published on the project website https://vedliot.eu/use-cases/open-call/ at the opening date. The evaluation of the Open Call proposals will be done by independent experts (external to the project). The proposals will be evaluated based on scientific and technological excellence, impact in the selected use-case area and AIoT and Edge computing in general, as well as clarity of implementation of the proposal.
